The bidder must maintain a minimum GeM Seller Rating of 4.5 as on the bid submission deadline. 8. The bidder shall have successfully executed similar supply orders for Government Departments, PSUs, o r Autonomous Bodies during the last three years. Copies of relevant contracts shall be submitted. 9. The bidder shall furnish audited financial statements, including the Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account , and Auditor’s Report,along with the corresponding Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for FY 2022–23, 2023–24,2 024–25, and 2025–26. Provisional or unaudited statements shall not be accepted. 10. The bidder shall submit a duly signed self-declaration confirming that they have not been blacklisted o r debarred by any Central or State Government Department, PSU, or Government Agency during the prece ding five years. 11. Submission of forged, fabricated, altered, or misleading documents shall result in bid rejection and ma y attract appropriate legal action by the purchaser. 14. The bidder shall submit an OEM-certified Technical Compliance Certificate confirming that the offered RO comply with all the technical specifications and requirements mentioned in the tender document. .
